text:
alex.brennan: Hey @support, after upgrading to the latest Node TypeScript SDK (0.22.0) a couple of our customers started getting 404s when calling the chat endpoint.

samir.rao: Can you paste the exact call and error? 404 usually means endpoint name mismatch or breaking deploy.

alex.brennan: Repro steps:
1) npm i @redwood/inference@0.22.0
2) call: `client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages })`
3) get: `HTTP 404 Not Found - route 'chat.create' not found`

Here is the minimal snippet:```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
```

jen-lee: Hmm, we shipped a server-side router rename in API v1.9 last week: `chat.create` -> `chat.generate`. SDK should have adapted but maybe a version skew. Which control-plane/host are you hitting? hosted or dedicated?

alex.brennan: Hosted (api.redwood.ai). Customer reported yesterday after CI bumped deps. I confirmed locally against hosted.

support-bot: Ticket RW-2026 created: "SDK call to chat.create returns 404 after API rename". Assigned to eng team.

kyle_t: I can take a look. Most likely the TS client codegen was out-of-sync: v0.22.0 still emits `chat.create` while server expects `chat.generate`. Two quick workarounds: 1) pin to previous API-compatible SDK (0.21.x) or 2) call REST directly to `POST /v1/chat/generate` until we release patch.

samir.rao: Can you paste your package.json and the lockfile lines so we know transitive versions? Also, any custom host override in env?

alex.brennan: package.json snippet:```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference": "0.22.0"
  }
}
```
No custom host. Lockfile shows @redwood/inference@0.22.0 resolved to 0.22.0.

kyle_t: Thanks. On the server we did a gradual rollout of API v1.9 yesterday which expects `chat.generate`. SDK release pipeline failed to publish codegen update for 0.22.0 — release notes missed it. I'll push a hotfix release 0.22.1 that maps the alias `chat.create` -> `chat.generate` and publish. ETA ~2h.

jen-lee: For customers: recommend pinning to 0.21.x while we push hotfix. Also add a quick note in status page that SDK mismatch may cause 404s for chat.* calls.

alex.brennan: Appreciate it. If you can confirm the hotfix version I can patch the customer's deployment. Also, do we need to log anything for billing / incident postmortem? They hit a few hundred failed calls.

kyle_t: Hotfix published: @redwood/inference@0.22.1 — it contains a compatibility shim so `client.chat.create` routes to `chat.generate`. Please test and confirm. I'll also open ENG-4325 to audit codegen + release gating.

alex.brennan: Quick test done — 0.22.1 fixes the 404s for me. No change needed to customer code. Thanks team :tada:

samir.rao: Adding a follow-up: we should add a deprecation warning in SDK logs when calling legacy routes so customers see clearer error messages next time. Filed DEVEX-291.

support-bot: RW-2026 updated: status -> resolved, fix deployed, customer notified.

alex.brennan: Closing from my side. Leaving notes for support docs: "If you see 404s after SDK upgrade, try pinning to previous minor or upgrade to 0.22.1. Check for route renames like chat.create -> chat.generate."
